item.title: Durham Forest, South Entrance - Intermediate Hike — Sun Nov 1, 9:30 AM
item.description:
GTA Hiking & Stuff Durham Forest is one of the few untouched areas remaining in the GTA. We will do a large loop enjoying many scenic views. It's a great time of year to hike the rolling hills as the forest explodes with fall colours.
Once we finish the hike, for those who are interested, we can do lunch at the Hub Restaurant, which overlooks the valleys below. The outdoor restaurant and patio should still be up and running.
The pace will be moderate, taking breaks along the way. We can adjust as needed. The length of the hike is roughly 9-10 km in 3hrs or less..
Come out and enjoy the crisp fall air and take in some forest bathing.
**Note**
- Arrive on time! Cancel if you can't make it. - Know your limits! Hike within your fitness level. - Dress for the conditions. - Proper footwear is required. - Be aware and prepared for ticks. - Free Parking. - No Dogs. - The hike will be canceled if the weather doesn't cooperate.
**We promptly leave at** 9:37 am.
Hope to see you there!
You

Whether you're a film nerd, popcorn enthusiast, or just looking for a chill night out with interesting people — this one's for you.
We’re heading out to see a movie together, then grabbing food or drinks after. If the film's great (or terrible), we’ll probably talk about it forever. If it’s just okay, we’ll talk about it for 10 minutes and move on to everything else — books, dating apps, weird dreams, how Toronto keeps getting more expensive, etc.
The vibe is relaxed, friendly, and not too serious. No film degree needed. No icebreakers. No pressure to “perform.” Just come enjoy the film, connect with some thoughtful people, and see where the night goes Click here to watch trailer!

item.title: 🍂 Crothers Woods Fall Hike & Ice Cream Treat! 🍦 — Sun Nov 8, 11:00 AM
item.description:
Try New Things in Toronto! ## 🍂 **Crothers Woods Fall Hike & Ice Cream Treat!** 🍦
Toronto doesn’t have many true hiking trails — but Crothers Woods is one of the best! This beautiful wooded trail is especially stunning in the fall, with the leaves turning every shade of red and gold. We’ll start by walking along **Broadview Avenue to Pottery Road**, heading down the hill to meet the **Don Valley Trail**. From there, we’ll join the **Crothers Woods Trail**, take in the fall colours, stop for a short break, and then walk back.
There are a few light hills — and one big one at the very end (Pottery Road, I’m looking at you!) — but don’t worry, there’s a sweet reward waiting. After all that hard work, we’ll stop for **Dairy Queen ice cream**! This hike is a bit more challenging than some of our regular walks, but totally worth it for the views (and the ice cream).
**This event happens rain or shine!**
***
